title: Only Animal That Cooks Its Own Food — Without Fire 😱
script: One animal processes raw food into something completely different — and it never uses heat. The wood ant, Formica rufa, floods its food with formic acid so concentrated it chemically breaks down proteins the way cooking does. Colonies in European forests have been doing this for over 50 million years. But here's the twist — they're not doing it for digestion. The acid also kills every parasite and fungus hiding in the food. So the ants aren't just cooking — they're running a food safety system older than any animal with a spine. Send this to someone who thinks cooking is a human invention.
search_summary: Wood ants use formic acid to chemically break down food proteins similar to cooking, killing parasites in the process.
comment_question: If ants figured out food safety 50 million years ago, what else are we taking credit for? 🐜
source_note: University of Regensburg, insect chemical ecology research, 2014
